initial_scale: RMS of rolling causal forecast residuals at common target times wholly inside the training prefix. All methods receive identical initial scales.
comparison: Path-paired proper interval score against horizon and shortest; same forecasts, threshold controllers, rates and initial scales. Pointwise Monte Carlo intervals; any invalid interval score invalidates the whole score group. No interval-score or conditional-coverage guarantee follows from the density surrogate.
scope: Second engineering pilot after paired dual-speed transfer did not improve interval score. All settings fixed before new independent pilot seeds; full profile uses further disjoint paths if retained. No tuning on confirmatory results.
mixture_rule: Per-lead geometric mixture of own-lead EWMA RMS and shortest-lead EWMA RMS times fixed training ratios. Start at equal weights. Update current weight by projected Student-t log-scale gradient computed from the old issued context, with learning_rate/(1+abs(loggap)). All scales and thresholds frozen at issuance; q is never clipped.
